name: navigation-drawer
title: Navigation drawer
summary: Lists a product's destinations in a panel at the start edge, grouped under headings and in groups that open and close, beside the content or over it, and narrows to a column of icons where the content needs the width, on request or by the window's width. Its destinations are buttons, or links to the product's pages: it is then a site's sidebar, which marks the page being shown.

anatomy.description: The panel at the start edge, the full height of its parent: expanded, the full drawer; collapsed, the icon column. Standard: part of the layout. Modal: above the content, its end corners rounded. Its color reaches under the system insets at its start, top and bottom.
The end edge of a standard drawer, and of a collapsible modal drawer's column, which sets it apart from the content beside it.
The modal layer's scrim (MDL-1): it dims everything behind a modal drawer; a press on it closes the drawer.

The top of the drawer, which stays in place while the items scroll: the header buttons (a menu button first) stacked in the icon column, the header slot's content beside the first of them while expanded, and the main action below them.

An icon-only Button in the header (an item of the header-button kind), on the icon column. While the drawer is collapsible, the first one is its menu button: it widens and narrows the drawer, and carries its expanded state. It stays the Button it is in both forms, with the Button's own size and shape (a circle in the default system).

The screen's main action (an item of the main-action kind), below the header buttons: its icon alone while the drawer is collapsed, its icon and label while expanded, its glyph in the same place in both.
A group of items (an item of the section kind) under an optional heading: its divider, its heading and its items, in that order. Not interactive, and never collapsed away.
A section's heading: text that names the items under it. Not interactive. Collapsed, its row keeps its height and its text is not drawn.
A divider component the drawer draws before a section whose divider is true, across the drawer's inner width in either form.

An expandable group of destinations (an item of the group kind): a row that opens and closes, and the destinations and groups it holds, whose rows start further in than its own while it is open. Collapsed, one cell.
The icon set's expand_more at the end of a group's row, turned half a turn while the group is open. Hidden from assistive technology.

One destination (an item of the destination kind), or a group's row: a cell across the drawer's width, which is its hit area and has the same height and place in both forms. A destination is a button, or a link while it has an href; the two are drawn alike.

The destination's box: a row with the corners of a menu's item, never a capsule in the default system. Expanded, the row across the drawer's inner width, a nested one starting further in; collapsed, the same row with its label gone: the box around its icon, as tall as before and with the same corners. It carries hover, focus and press, and is filled as the active indicator while the destination is selected; the fill changes in place and never grows in width.

The box behind the icon alone, the icon centered in it. The default system leaves it transparent; a system that marks a collapsed destination behind its glyph only (Material's) fills it there and leaves the collapsed item container clear.
The destination's glyph (its icon), centered on the icon column in both forms. Outlined when unselected, filled when selected.

The destination's name: beside the icon while expanded (its label, wrapping). Collapsed, no label is drawn unless collapsedLabels asks for the short label under the icon, on one line. Its label is always its accessible name.

The end of an expanded row: the trailing slot's content (a glyph such as open_in_new) or else the destination's trailing text (a count such as "24", a word such as "New"), quieter than the label. Not interactive; part of the destination's description.
A Tanrei badge anchored to the icon in both forms, drawn from the destination's badge, badgeCount and badgeLabel: a dot or a count (the badge component).
Gap-then-ring indicator around the item container, shown for keyboard focus.

props.name: variant
props.description: Standard sits beside the content and takes its width in the layout; modal lays itself over the content with a scrim and holds focus until it closes. One product uses both: standard where the window is wide enough, modal where it is not. A design system may add values. Ignored while responsive is true, when the window's width chooses.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the drawer is shown: for a standard drawer, whether it takes its place in the layout (in the form collapsible and expanded choose); for a modal one, whether it is presented over the content (while collapsible, its collapsed column stays in the layout when it is not). While responsive is true it only says whether the drawer is shown over the content in the presentations that are modal, and every change of presentation sets it back to false.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Gives the drawer a collapsed form, the icon column. A standard drawer then shows the form expanded chooses; a modal one shows its column in the layout while closed and widens over the content while open. While false the drawer is always expanded and lays its rows out for that form alone.

props.name: expanded
props.description: The form of a collapsible standard drawer: true for the full drawer, false for the icon column. Ignored while collapsible is false, and by a modal drawer, whose form follows open. It is the user's choice: a change of the window's width never writes it, so a responsive drawer returns to it when the window is wide again.

props.name: collapsedLabels
props.description: Which cells draw their short label under the icon while the drawer is collapsed: none of them (the default: a collapsed drawer is the expanded one with its labels gone), only the selected one's, or all of them, for a product or a design system whose collapsed column is labelled. A label that is not drawn is still the destination's accessible name.

props.name: density
props.description: How much room a row takes, in a tree view's words. regular (a 48 row with a 24 glyph in the default system, a menu item's row) is the drawer of a product used by touch as well as by pointer. compact (a 32 row with a 16 glyph, a tree view's compact row) is for a tool used with a pointer whose drawer lists many places. It sets the rows, the section headings, the paddings, the glyphs, the nesting indent and the collapsed column alike — never the gap between the icon and the label — so both forms follow it; for touch a row is never lower than the touch target in either. A design system may add values.

props.name: chevron
props.description: Where a group's chevron is drawn, as the tree view's: start, before its icon (every row then keeps the chevron's room, so the icons of a level stand in one column); end, at the very end of the row, after its trailing content; none, no chevron — the arrow keys still open and close a group, and with a pointer a press on the group's icon does, the icon showing openIcon while the group is open (NVD-68). A collapsible drawer draws start as end, so that every icon keeps its point in both forms.

props.name: guides
props.description: Whether an open group draws a line down beside what it holds, as the tree view's: none; shown, always; hover, while the pointer is over the drawer or focus is in it, fading in and out (NVD-73).

props.name: indent
props.description: How much further a level's rows begin than their group's, as the tree view's: null (auto, the default) lines a row's first part (its chevron, icon or label) up with where its group's label begins, and steps by comp.navigation-drawer.item.nest-indent where the group has neither a start chevron nor an icon; a number steps by that many units of the layout at every level, 0 none (NVD-69). On the web the attribute takes auto or a number.

props.name: highlight
props.description: How far the selected fill and the hover and press layers of a nested row reach, as the tree view's: indented, from where the row begins (its indent) to the end; full, across the drawer's whole inner width at every level (NVD-70).

props.name: iconSpace
props.description: Whether a row without an icon keeps the icon's room, as the tree view's: auto, where another row of its level has an icon, so that the labels of a level line up; always; never (NVD-71).

props.name: expandable
props.description: Whether groups open and close at all, as the tree view's. While false every group is shown open, draws no chevron, has no toggle and is not exposed as expandable: its row names the list of its items (NVD-72). It is not collapsible, which narrows the drawer itself.

props.name: labelWrap
props.description: Lets a row's label wrap onto more lines, as the tree view's. While false (the default) a label is one line, cut with an ellipsis, and its full text is shown in a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus wherever it is cut (NVD-75).

props.name: supportingWrap
props.description: Lets a row's supporting text wrap, as labelWrap lets its label.

props.name: responsive
props.description: Lets the window's width choose the drawer's presentation (NVD-53): beside the content where the window is wide, its collapsed column beside the content where it is narrower (while collapsible), and over the content alone where it is narrow. While true the drawer ignores variant, shows itself in a wide window whatever open says, and closes whenever the width changes its presentation.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the selected destination (selection is the drawer's, by a destination's value), wherever it stands, in a section, in a group or neither. Empty selects none. The selected destination is the place the product is showing, and it is exposed as the current page: in a product whose pages are separate documents nothing is selected by a press, and each page sets value to the destination that is that page (a link's href stands as its value while it has none, NVD-59).

props.name: revealSelected
props.description: Opens the groups that hold the selected destination when the drawer first appears and whenever value changes, so that the place the product is showing is drawn and not only the closed group that holds it (NVD-58). A site's sidebar sets it; while false a closed group stays closed and its row shows the selection (NVD-47). The user may still close such a group afterwards.

props.name: selectableGroups
props.description: Lets a group be a destination as well as a row that opens and closes: a setting of the product's, off by default. While true a group that has a value or an href is a place of its own (NVD-66) — a section's overview page in a site, a folder that is shown when it is chosen — which the drawer's value selects, whose activation emits change or reselect and which an href makes a link; its chevron becomes a control of its own that opens and closes it, and the rest of its row chooses it (NVD-67). A group without either still only opens and closes. While false every group only opens and closes, whatever value or href it has.

props.name: scrollOffset
props.description: How far the drawer's items are scrolled from their start, in the units of the layout. The product may set it, before the drawer first appears included, and the drawer scrolls there at once; reading it gives the present distance. It is the handle by which a product keeps a long drawer where the user left it from one page to the next (NVD-61, NVD-62); the drawer stores nothing itself.

props.name: stickyParents
props.description: Keeps the rows of the open groups that the rows at the top of the drawer belong to pinned there while their items scroll under them, as the tree view's (on by default there, off here) and as VS Code's sticky scroll (NVD-77). Not applied while the drawer is collapsed.

props.name: stickyMax
props.description: At most how many group rows are pinned, one per level, the innermost winning, as VS Code keeps its innermost scopes (NVD-77).

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: What the loading row under a group that is fetching its items says ("Loading…"), and its accessible name, as the tree view's: Tanrei ships no words of its own.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the drawer for assistive technology ("Mail"): the navigation landmark on the web, and the modal drawer as a whole on every platform.

items.name: destination
items.summary: One destination of the drawer: an icon, a label, optional trailing content at the end of its row and an optional badge on its icon. Collapsed, its icon alone. With an href it is a link to that address and not a button.

props.name: value
props.description: What identifies the destination. The drawer's value selects the destination whose value equals it; change and reselect carry it. Unique within the drawer. Empty on a link, its href stands as its value.

props.name: href
props.description: The address the destination leads to. Not empty, the destination is a link and not a button (NVD-59): it is followed as the platform follows a link, and the drawer does not select it by itself (NVD-60). Empty, the destination is a button and the product moves on change. As the Button's href (a control with a destination is a link).

props.name: target
props.description: Where a link opens, as the Button's target. same: where the person is. new: a new context — a new tab or window on the web, outside the current screen elsewhere — which the expanded row marks with the glyph open_in_new at its end unless the product put trailing content there, and says through targetLabel (NVD-63). A link that opens elsewhere is never selected by a press (NVD-60). Ignored without href.

props.name: targetLabel
props.description: What assistive technology reads after the link's name while target is new ("opens in a new tab"), as the Button's targetLabel: Tanrei ships no words of its own. Required while target is new; ignored otherwise.

props.name: label
props.description: Its name, drawn beside the icon while the drawer is expanded and always its accessible name. Required.

props.name: supportingText
props.description: A few words about the row ("3 new", "shared with the team"), under its label or after it (supportingPosition), quieter than the label, read as its description after its name. Empty draws none (NVD-74).

props.name: supportingPosition
props.description: Where the supporting text stands, as the tree view's: below, on a line of its own under the label; inline, after the label on its line (NVD-74).

props.name: shortLabel
props.description: What the collapsed drawer draws under the icon, on one line ("Files" for "My files"), where collapsedLabels asks for labels. Empty draws the label, truncated if it does not fit. It should be a part of the label, which stays the accessible name.

props.name: icon
props.description: The name of its glyph in the system's icon set, drawn in the destination's own icon style: outlined while unselected, filled while selected. Empty draws no icon; give every destination of a drawer an icon, or none, and every top-level one an icon in a collapsible drawer.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes it unavailable. It keeps its place, draws its disabled look, cannot be activated and leaves the focus order.

props.name: trailingText
props.description: Short text at the end of the expanded row, a count or a word ("24", "New"), quieter than the label. Empty draws none; the trailing slot's content, when there is any, is drawn instead.

props.name: badge
props.description: Draws a Tanrei badge (the badge component) on the icon, in both forms, from badgeCount and badgeLabel.

props.name: badgeCount
props.description: The badge's count, as the badge component's count: null draws the dot, 0 draws nothing, above 0 the number (above 999 as 999+). Ignored while badge is false.

props.name: badgeLabel
props.description: The badge's label, as the badge component's: what assistive technology reads after the destination's name and state ("3 unread"). A dot needs one. Ignored while badge is false.

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: Content at the end of the expanded row, in place of trailingText: a glyph (open_in_new for a destination that opens elsewhere), a short text. Not interactive. A count belongs in trailingText, and a badge on the icon (badge): a Badge needs an anchor, and the end of the row has none. A fixture item's content is a glyph drawn here.

items.name: group
items.summary: A group of destinations under a row that opens and closes it: an icon, a label and a chevron. It holds destinations and groups, not sections, and their rows start further in than its own. While the drawer's selectableGroups is true and it has a value or an href, it is a destination as well (NVD-66): its row chooses it and its chevron opens and closes it.

props.name: label
props.description: Its name, drawn in its row and used as the accessible name of its row and of the list of its items. Required.

props.name: shortLabel
props.description: What the collapsed drawer draws under its icon where collapsedLabels asks for labels; empty draws the label, as a destination's.

props.name: icon
props.description: The name of its glyph in the system's icon set, drawn as a destination's icon.

props.name: openIcon
props.description: A second glyph, drawn in the icon's place while the group is open (folder_open beside folder), as the tree view's. Ignored while icon is empty.

props.name: supportingText
props.description: A few words about the group ("3 new", "shared with the team"), under its label or after it (supportingPosition), quieter than the label, read as its description after its name. Empty draws none (NVD-74).

props.name: supportingPosition
props.description: Where the supporting text stands, as the tree view's: below, on a line of its own under the label; inline, after the label on its line (NVD-74).

props.name: trailingText
props.description: Short text at the end of the group's expanded row (a count), before an end chevron, as a destination's; the trailing slot's content, when there is any, is drawn instead.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes its row unavailable: it keeps its place and its open state, draws its disabled look, cannot be toggled and leaves the focus order. Its items keep their own disabled.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether its items are shown under its row while the drawer is expanded.

props.name: loading
props.description: Says that the product is fetching the group's items: while the group is open a loading row is drawn under it, after any items it already holds, and the list of its items is exposed as busy (NVD-76).

props.name: value
props.description: What identifies the group as a destination, read only while the drawer's selectableGroups is true (NVD-66): the drawer's value selects the group whose value equals it, as it selects a destination, and change and reselect carry it. Unique among the drawer's destinations and groups. Empty on a link, its href stands as its value; empty with no href, the group is not a destination and only opens and closes.

props.name: href
props.description: The address the group leads to as a destination, read only while the drawer's selectableGroups is true: not empty, its row is a link and not a button (NVD-59, NVD-60), opened where the person is. Ignored while selectableGroups is false.

events.name: toggle
events.description: The user opened or closed the group from its row, or from its cell in the collapsed drawer, or the drawer opened it to show the selected destination (NVD-58); carries its new open state.

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: Content at the end of the group's expanded row, before an end chevron, in place of trailingText: a glyph of the icon set, as a destination's trailing slot. Not interactive. A count belongs in trailingText.

items.name: section
items.summary: A group of destinations and groups under an optional heading, with an optional divider before it. It is not interactive and does not nest.

props.name: title
props.description: The text that names the items under it, exposed as a heading. Empty draws no heading row.

props.name: divider
props.description: Draws a divider (the divider component) before the section, to set it apart from what is above it.

items.name: header-button
items.summary: An icon-only Button in the header, on the icon column (a menu button): a Button of the text variant and the medium size with an icon and no label, unless the product sets otherwise, which the drawer lays out and does not restyle, resize or reshape in either form. While the drawer is collapsible the first one is its menu button.

props.name: label
props.description: Its accessible name, as the Button's label. Required.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Its glyph, as the Button's icon slot. A fixture item's content is this glyph.

events.name: click
events.description: The button was activated, as the Button's click.

items.name: main-action
items.summary: The screen's main action, below the header buttons: the Main Action Button component, whose extended the drawer sets from its own form (collapsed to its icon while the drawer is collapsed). The drawer lays it out and does not restyle it.

props.name: label
props.description: Its label, drawn while the drawer is expanded and always its accessible name, as the Main Action Button's. Required.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Its glyph, as the Main Action Button's icon slot. A fixture item's content is this glyph.

events.name: click
events.description: The button was activated, as the Main Action Button's click.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Content the product puts in the header beside the first header button (a title, an account switcher); the drawer does not restyle it. Drawn only while the drawer is expanded; collapsed, its row keeps its height.

events.name: change
events.description: The user activated a destination that is not the selected one, or a group that is one (NVD-66); carries its value and, for a link, its href. For a link it comes before the link is followed, only for an activation that follows it in place (NVD-60), and a product that cancels it follows the link itself.

events.name: reselect
events.description: The user activated the destination that is already selected; carries its value and, for a link, its href, as change does.

events.name: close
events.description: A modal drawer closed, or asks its controlled owner to close it: by the scrim, Escape, the platform's back action, a drag toward its edge, its menu button, or after a destination was activated.

events.name: expandedChange
events.description: The user asked a collapsible drawer for its other form, with its menu button or a group's cell in the collapsed drawer; carries true to expand and false to collapse. For a collapsible modal drawer, true asks it to open.

events.name: presentationChange
events.description: A responsive drawer decided its presentation for the first time, or the window's width changed it; carries standard (beside the content), column (its collapsed column beside the content, widening over it) or modal (over the content alone). A product shows its own menu button while the presentation is modal.

behavior.text: WHEN the user activates a destination by pointer, touch, Enter or Space (Enter only for a destination that is a link, and for a link only an activation that NVD-60 counts) THE navigation drawer SHALL emit change exactly once with the destination's value WHILE it is not the selected destination, and reselect exactly once with its value WHILE it is.
WHILE a destination's disabled is true THE navigation drawer SHALL NOT emit change or reselect for it, SHALL NOT make it focusable and SHALL expose it as disabled to assistive technology.

THE navigation drawer SHALL draw the destination whose value equals the drawer's value, in a section, in a group or neither, from the selected parts and every other destination from the unselected parts: WHILE the drawer is expanded, from selected (comp.navigation-drawer.selected.item.container.color, comp.navigation-drawer.selected.item.icon-indicator.color, comp.navigation-drawer.selected.item.icon.color, comp.navigation-drawer.selected.item.label.color, comp.navigation-drawer.selected.item.trailing-text.color, comp.navigation-drawer.selected.item.trailing-icon.color) and unselected; WHILE it is collapsed, from collapsed-selected (comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed-selected.item.container.color, comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed-selected.item.icon-indicator.color, comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed-selected.item.icon.color, comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed-selected.item.label.color) and collapsed-unselected. IF no destination's value equals a value that is not empty THE navigation drawer SHALL draw every destination unselected, and in debug builds report the value.

WHILE a destination or a group's row is hovered, keyboard-focused or pressed THE navigation drawer SHALL render its item container, icon indicator, icon, label, trailing content and opacity from the component tokens of its condition in the highest-precedence active state, with precedence pressed over focused over hovered; focus gained by pointer or touch SHALL NOT select the focused state.
behavior.verify: Test under the `acme` fixture system, which values hovered, focused and pressed differently.

behavior.text: WHEN a destination or a group's row receives keyboard focus THE navigation drawer SHALL show the focus ring around its item container without animation; focus gained by pointer or touch SHALL NOT show it.

THE navigation drawer SHALL make each cell (a destination's or a group's row) its hit area, across the drawer's full width inside its insets, however deep it is nested (NVD-13), and the cell's height with half of comp.navigation-drawer.container.gap.regular above and below it, in both forms, and SHALL NOT let it fall below sys.target.pointer high for a fine pointer WHILE density is regular, nor below sys.target.touch for touch; a system whose geometry gives less SHALL still extend the hit area without changing the drawn cell. WHILE density is compact, for a fine pointer the hit area SHALL be the cell and half of the gap above and below it, the one place where a cell of the drawer is lower than the pointer target (still above the 24 of WCAG 2.5.8); WHERE input is touch, or the platform cannot tell the input type, a compact cell SHALL be drawn at least sys.target.touch high, because cells whose hit areas touch cannot extend them over each other. Hover and press over any part of the hit area SHALL answer on the item container.
behavior.verify: Under the default system: a regular cell is 48 high and its hit area 52 for every input; a compact cell is 32 high and its hit area 34 for a mouse, and a compact cell is drawn 48 high for touch.

behavior.text: WHILE a destination's or a group's disabled is true THE navigation drawer SHALL render its item container, icon indicator, icon, label, trailing content and opacity from the disabled component tokens of its condition.

WHEN a destination or a group's row is pressed by pointer, touch, Enter or Space THE navigation drawer SHALL show its pressed state without delay and SHALL keep it visible for at least sys.motion.duration.press-hold, even when the press ends sooner.

WHILE a destination or a group's row is pressed THE navigation drawer SHALL answer as sys.behavior.pressed-feedback names: overlay applies the pressed tokens to the whole item container at once; ripple grows the pressed state layer, clipped to the item container, from the point of contact (from the center for keyboard activation); dim applies the pressed opacity to the whole destination and draws no state layer; none draws no answer to the press. Under ripple and dim only the item container color stays with the state under the press; icon indicator, icon, label, trailing content and opacity still come from the pressed tokens. Under none every part stays with the state under the press. The ripple grows over comp.navigation-drawer.motion.feedback-duration with comp.navigation-drawer.motion.state-easing, fades over comp.navigation-drawer.motion.state-duration with comp.navigation-drawer.motion.state-easing once the press has ended and press-hold has passed, and appears whole where motion is reduced.
behavior.verify: Test under a system that sets each value; `m3-like` is ripple, `cupertino` is dim, the default is overlay.

behavior.text: THE navigation drawer SHALL ease its item container and icon indicator corners and a modal drawer's end corners by sys.shape.corner-smoothing (0 is a quarter circle, 0.6 the iOS continuous corner; a platform with only the OS curve draws it for any amount above 0) and show its keyboard focus as sys.behavior.focus-style names (ring or glow); a platform that cannot draw a choice SHALL fall back to the first value and state that in its README.
behavior.verify: `cupertino` is continuous; the `acme` fixture system is glow.

behavior.text: THE navigation drawer SHALL be comp.navigation-drawer.container.width wide while expanded and comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.container.width.regular wide while collapsed, beside the start inset, and the full height of its parent, filled with its variant's container color (comp.navigation-drawer.container.color.standard or comp.navigation-drawer.container.color.modal), raised by its variant's elevation (comp.navigation-drawer.container.elevation.standard, comp.navigation-drawer.container.elevation.modal), with its end corners rounded by its variant's shape (comp.navigation-drawer.container.shape.standard, comp.navigation-drawer.container.shape.modal) and square start corners, and edged at its end by comp.navigation-drawer.outline.width of its variant's outline color (comp.navigation-drawer.outline.color.standard, comp.navigation-drawer.outline.color.modal); right-to-left layouts SHALL put it at the right edge, mirrored.

THE navigation drawer SHALL lay out, comp.navigation-drawer.container.padding-inline from its start and end and comp.navigation-drawer.container.padding-block from its top and bottom (measured to the first and last cell, not to their hit areas), its header (NVD-38) and then, comp.navigation-drawer.header.gap below it (at the padding WHILE the header is empty), its items in reading order: destinations, groups and sections, a section laying out its divider, its heading and its items in that order, and an open group its row and then its items; it SHALL put comp.navigation-drawer.container.gap.regular between two cells, and WHILE the items are taller than the space below the header it SHALL scroll them and keep the header in place, in both forms.

WHILE the drawer is expanded THE navigation drawer SHALL draw each destination as an item container that ends comp.navigation-drawer.container.padding-inline inside the drawer's end edge and starts comp.navigation-drawer.container.padding-inline inside its start edge, further in by the row's indent (NVD-69) WHILE highlight is indented and at that same place at every level WHILE highlight is full (NVD-70), its content starting the row's indent further in either way; comp.navigation-drawer.item.container.height.regular high unless its label's lines need more, with corners comp.navigation-drawer.item.container.shape, holding in reading order: its icon, centered on the icon column's center line (half of comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.container.width.regular from the drawer's start edge, the row's indent further, and a chevron's room and comp.navigation-drawer.item.gap further WHILE chevron is start) and on the cell's icon line (NVD-31), with its icon indicator centered behind it and taking no space; a group's start chevron before it WHILE chevron is start (NVD-68); its label in comp.navigation-drawer.item.label.typescale.regular, comp.navigation-drawer.item.gap after the icon or the icon's room (NVD-71), or comp.navigation-drawer.item.padding-inline.regular from where the row's content starts WHILE it has neither, on one line unless labelWrap is true (NVD-75), and its supporting text (NVD-74); and its trailing content (NVD-43) at the end, before an end chevron, comp.navigation-drawer.item.gap after the label and comp.navigation-drawer.item.padding-inline.regular from the item container's end. Right-to-left layouts SHALL mirror it.
behavior.verify: Under the default system a row is 48 high and the icon column's center line is 36 from the drawer's start edge, so a top-level icon has 12 on its start side inside its item container, as it has above and below it (chevron end). In `nested-icons` (chevron end) a nested destination's icon is centered 72 from the start edge, its start 60, where its group's label starts, and its item container starts there too (highlight indented); in `highlight-full` it starts 12 from the start edge, as a top-level one's does. In `compact` (chevron end) a top-level icon is 16 and centered 28 from the start edge and its label 48 from it; one level deep the icon is centered 56, starting at 48, where its group's label starts.

WHILE a section's title is not empty THE navigation drawer SHALL draw it as the section's heading in comp.navigation-drawer.heading.typescale and comp.navigation-drawer.heading.color, in a row at least comp.navigation-drawer.heading.height.regular high with the text vertically centered and starting where the destinations' labels start WHILE they have no icon (comp.navigation-drawer.item.padding-inline.regular inside the drawer's inner edge), and SHALL expose it as a heading that is not focusable; WHILE the drawer is collapsed it SHALL keep the row at its height, draw no text in it and hide it from assistive technology; WHILE the title is empty the section SHALL draw no heading row. THE navigation drawer SHALL set the heading's letter-spacing by the script of its text, as every title is set (PRS-20): no negative letter-spacing WHERE its language is Chinese, Japanese or Korean, and none WHERE its script joins its letters or stacks marks on them.

WHILE a section's divider is true THE navigation drawer SHALL draw a divider component before the section, across the drawer's inner width in either form, and leave it as the divider component draws it; IF a section holds a section, or a group holds a section, THE navigation drawer SHALL render the inner section's items in its place, and in debug builds report that sections do not nest and do not go inside a group.

WHILE variant is standard THE navigation drawer SHALL take its width in the layout, in its current form (NVD-30), WHILE open is true and no width and no presence to assistive technology or focus WHILE open is false; WHEN open changes it SHALL slide in or out while the content beside it resizes, over comp.navigation-drawer.motion.enter-duration with comp.navigation-drawer.motion.enter-easing when opening and comp.navigation-drawer.motion.exit-duration with comp.navigation-drawer.motion.exit-easing when closing, and at once where motion is reduced. A standard drawer SHALL draw no scrim, SHALL NOT keep focus inside it and SHALL NOT emit close.

WHEN open becomes true WHILE variant is modal THE navigation drawer SHALL, WHILE collapsible is false, slide in from its start edge over the content and fade its modal layer's scrim in comp.navigation-drawer.scrim.color and comp.navigation-drawer.scrim.blur in over the rest of the window in step (MDL-1, MDL-7), over comp.navigation-drawer.motion.enter-duration with comp.navigation-drawer.motion.enter-easing (at once where motion is reduced), and WHILE collapsible is true widen from its column as NVD-40 says; in both cases it SHALL move focus to the selected destination (or the group row that shows it, NVD-47) or else to its first focusable element, SHALL keep focus inside the drawer while it is open, and SHALL make everything behind it inert to pointer, touch, keyboard and assistive technology, as its modal layer does (MDL-2, MDL-3, MDL-4).

WHEN the user presses the scrim, presses Escape, uses the platform's back action (as its modal layer answers them, MDL-6), activates the menu button (NVD-37), or drags the drawer toward its start edge past half its width or flings it that way, WHILE variant is modal and open is true, THE navigation drawer SHALL close and emit close exactly once; on the web it SHALL set open to false itself, as a dialog does, and a controlled platform SHALL leave open to the caller, who sets it from close. A fling is a release faster than the platform's minimum fling velocity (Android's ViewConfiguration.getScaledMinimumFlingVelocity, Flutter's kMinFlingVelocity) or, where the platform names none (the web, SwiftUI, React Native), 0.5 points per millisecond, and the drawer follows a drag only beyond the platform's touch slop (Android's ViewConfiguration.getScaledTouchSlop, Flutter's kTouchSlop) or, where the platform names none, 8 points, as BSH-9 says for the bottom sheet. A release's velocity is the pointer's over its last moves: WHERE the pointer has not moved for longer than the time after which the platform's velocity tracker takes a pointer as stopped (40 milliseconds in Android's VelocityTracker, Jetpack Compose's VelocityTracker and Flutter's VelocityTracker) or, where the platform names none (the web, SwiftUI, React Native), 40 milliseconds before the release THE navigation drawer SHALL take the release as having no velocity, so that a drag that stops where it is wanted and is let go there is no fling, however fast it moved before it stopped.

WHEN the user activates a destination WHILE variant is modal THE navigation drawer SHALL emit change or reselect as NVD-1 says, and then close and emit close as NVD-20 says; an activation of a link that NVD-60 does not count, which opens the link somewhere else, SHALL leave the drawer open.

WHEN a modal drawer closes THE navigation drawer SHALL, WHILE collapsible is false, slide out and fade its scrim out over comp.navigation-drawer.motion.exit-duration with comp.navigation-drawer.motion.exit-easing, and WHILE collapsible is true narrow back to its column as NVD-40 says (at once where motion is reduced), and SHALL return focus to the element that had it when the drawer opened, or, WHERE that element is gone, to where the platform puts focus by default, as its modal layer does (MDL-5).

THE navigation drawer SHALL expose each destination as one element named by its label in both forms, with its selected state and its position among the items of its level, and its icon hidden: a link WHILE its href is not empty (NVD-59) and a button otherwise. On the web it is an anchor or a button inside a navigation landmark named by the drawer's label, the selected destination carrying aria-current="page"; on Apple platforms, Android, Flutter and React Native a button, or a link, with the selected state. The selected destination is the place the product is showing, in a product of one screen and in a site of many pages alike: THE navigation drawer SHALL have no second state and no second mark for a current page, and SHALL expose exactly one destination, or none, as current. It SHALL expose groups as NVD-46 says. WHILE variant is modal and open is true THE navigation drawer SHALL also be a modal dialog named by the drawer's label (the web's dialog element; the modal trait or pane title elsewhere).

WHILE a destination's label is empty and the product gives the destination a name of its own on the element — aria-label, or aria-labelledby naming an element — THE navigation drawer SHALL expose that name as its accessible name; WHILE a destination's label is empty and the product gives it none THE navigation drawer SHALL still render it, and in debug builds report that it has no accessible name; WHILE the drawer's label is empty and variant is modal it SHALL report that the dialog has no name.
THE navigation drawer SHALL extend its container under the system insets at its start, top and bottom and SHALL place its header, destinations and sections inside them.

WHEN variant or density names a value that the active design system does not have THE navigation drawer SHALL render with that axis's default value's tokens, and in debug builds report the unknown value.

WHILE the text size is enlarged THE navigation drawer SHALL keep both its widths, grow each cell and section heading with its text in both forms alike (their heights are minimums, NVD-31), keep one-line labels, one-line supporting text and short labels on one line and cut them (NVD-75), and SHALL NOT scale its icons, icon indicators or trailing glyphs; WHERE the platform offers a large-content viewer for bar items (iOS) a long press on a collapsed destination SHALL show its icon and label enlarged.

WHEN open changes from false to true WHILE variant is standard THE navigation drawer SHALL move focus to the selected destination or else to its first focusable element, and WHEN open then changes to false while focus is inside it SHALL return focus to the element that had it when the drawer opened, or, WHERE that element is gone, to where the platform puts focus by default; Tab and Shift+Tab SHALL move focus out of an open standard drawer without closing it (a standard drawer is a layout region, not an overlay).
IF two destinations have the same value THE navigation drawer SHALL treat the first of them in reading order as the one the drawer's value selects, and in debug builds report the repeated value.

WHILE collapsible is false THE navigation drawer SHALL be expanded and ignore expanded; WHILE collapsible is true and variant is standard it SHALL be expanded WHILE expanded is true and collapsed WHILE expanded is false; WHILE collapsible is true and variant is modal it SHALL be collapsed, in the layout, WHILE open is false, and expanded over the content WHILE open is true (NVD-40), ignoring expanded.

WHILE collapsible is true THE navigation drawer SHALL give every cell the same height and the same place in both forms, so that each icon, each header button and the main action's glyph is drawn at exactly the same point expanded, collapsed and while moving between them: a cell's icon line SHALL lie below its top by the larger of half the expanded row's height (NVD-13) and comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.item.container.padding-block.regular plus half of comp.navigation-drawer.item.icon-indicator.height.regular, and the cell SHALL reach below that line by the larger of half the expanded row's height and half of comp.navigation-drawer.item.icon-indicator.height.regular plus, WHILE collapsedLabels is not never, comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.item.gap and one line of comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.item.label.typescale, plus comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.item.container.padding-block.regular; both forms SHALL center the icon on that line. A section heading's row, and the header slot's row, SHALL keep their heights in both forms. The one exception is an open group, whose items the collapsed drawer does not draw (NVD-47): the cells after it move up while the drawer collapses and back while it expands. WHILE collapsible is false a cell SHALL be the expanded row alone.

With collapsedLabels always a cell grows to hold the short label in both forms alike (`collapsed-labels-always`).

behavior.text: WHILE the drawer is collapsed THE navigation drawer SHALL draw only the cells that are not inside a group (top-level destinations and groups, in a section or not), each as an item container comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.item.container.width.regular wide, centered in the icon column, with corners comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.item.container.shape, each at most half its height, holding, comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.item.container.padding-block.regular below its top, the icon indicator, comp.navigation-drawer.item.icon-indicator.width.regular wide and comp.navigation-drawer.item.icon-indicator.height.regular high with corners comp.navigation-drawer.item.icon-indicator.shape, its icon centered in it on the cell's icon line; and WHILE its short label is drawn (NVD-33), comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.item.gap below the icon indicator, the short label centered on one line in comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.item.label.typescale, truncated at its end with an ellipsis inside comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.item.container.padding-inline, and comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.item.container.padding-block.regular below it. behavior.text: WHILE the drawer is collapsed and collapsedLabels is never THE navigation drawer SHALL draw no short label, so that a collapsed cell is its expanded row with the label and trailing content gone; WHILE it is selected it SHALL draw only the short label of the cell drawn selected (the selected destination, or the group that shows it, NVD-47); WHILE it is always it SHALL draw every cell's short label. Every destination's label SHALL remain its accessible name.

THE navigation drawer SHALL draw a collapsed cell's shortLabel, or its label WHILE shortLabel is empty, and SHALL keep its label as its accessible name in both forms; IF shortLabel is not empty and is not a part of label (ignoring case) THE navigation drawer SHALL still draw it, and in debug builds report that the visible name is not part of the accessible name.

WHEN the drawer changes form (NVD-30) THE navigation drawer SHALL, over comp.navigation-drawer.motion.expand-duration with comp.navigation-drawer.motion.expand-easing: move its end edge between comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.container.width.regular and comp.navigation-drawer.container.width, a standard drawer's content beside it resizing with it; keep every icon, header button and the main action's glyph in place (NVD-31); change each item container between its two sizes and corners as one shape around the same icon line (WHERE the two forms give it the same height and corners, as the default system does, its end edge alone moves), and cross-fade its color and those of its icon indicator, icon and label from one form's condition to the other's; clip the expanded labels, trailing content, headings' text and the header slot at the moving edge and fade them out over the first half of the change when collapsing, and in over the second half when expanding; and fade the short labels in over the second half when collapsing, and out over the first half when expanding. WHEN the drawer changes form THE navigation drawer SHALL keep focus where it is, and SHALL take what the collapsed form does not draw (the header slot's content, the headings' text, trailing content, the chevron of a group that is a destination, the items inside groups) out of the focus order and away from assistive technology WHILE it is collapsed; IF focus is on such content when the drawer collapses THE navigation drawer SHALL move it to the menu button (NVD-37), or else to the first focusable element of the drawer. A destination's role, name and state SHALL be the same in both forms.

WHILE collapsible is true THE navigation drawer SHALL treat its first header button as its menu button and expose it as expanded or collapsed, controlling the drawer (aria-expanded and aria-controls on the web; the expanded state elsewhere); WHEN the user activates it, after the button's own click, THE navigation drawer SHALL emit expandedChange exactly once with the form asked for (true to expand, false to collapse) WHILE variant is standard or the drawer is not open, and on the web apply it itself (expanded for a standard drawer, open for a modal one); WHILE a modal drawer is open it SHALL close as NVD-20 says instead. THE navigation drawer SHALL lay out its header from the top: its header buttons stacked in the icon column, each centered on its center line, comp.navigation-drawer.header.item-gap apart, and each drawn as the Button it is in both forms and while the drawer moves between them: the Button's own size, shape (a circle in the default system) and colors, never stretched to a row's width, never given an item container's shape and never filled as an active indicator; WHILE expanded, the header slot's content in the first header button's row, comp.navigation-drawer.item.gap after it (from comp.navigation-drawer.container.padding-inline WHILE there is no header button), vertically centered, the row as tall as the taller of the two, the slot's box giving what it holds comp.navigation-drawer.header.typescale and comp.navigation-drawer.header.color as an inherited text style, so that plain text placed there is drawn in the system's title style and an element that sets its own style keeps it; and then the main action (NVD-39), comp.navigation-drawer.header.item-gap below. A header-button or main-action item SHALL go to the header wherever it stands among the items, and the header's content SHALL come first in reading and focus order and keep its own semantics.

NVD-19 to NVD-22 apply to it while it is open.

WHEN the selected destination changes THE navigation drawer SHALL change the new destination's item container to its selected color and the previous one's to its unselected color in place, each at its full size and shape throughout, and change icon, label and trailing content colors and icon fill, over comp.navigation-drawer.motion.state-duration with comp.navigation-drawer.motion.state-easing, in either form; it SHALL NOT grow, shrink, slide or otherwise resize an item container to show a selection. THE icon indicator, which the default system leaves transparent, SHALL grow in width from its center to its full width, at its full height throughout, on the new destination and fade out on the previous one, over comp.navigation-drawer.motion.selection-duration with comp.navigation-drawer.motion.selection-easing; WHILE the drawer is collapsed and collapsedLabels is selected the short labels SHALL appear and disappear over the same time without moving any cell (NVD-31); WHERE motion is reduced it SHALL show the new selection at once.

behavior.text: WHILE a destination's badge is true THE navigation drawer SHALL draw a Tanrei badge anchored to its icon in both forms, above the icon indicator, as the badge component draws one whose count is the destination's badgeCount and whose label is its badgeLabel, SHALL keep it while the destination is disabled, and SHALL expose the badge's description (badgeLabel, or the displayed count when it is empty) as part of the destination's own description, after its name and state.

WHILE a destination's trailing slot holds content THE navigation drawer SHALL draw it at the end of the expanded row: a glyph at comp.navigation-drawer.item.trailing-icon.size.regular in its condition's trailing icon color (comp.navigation-drawer.unselected.item.trailing-icon.color, comp.navigation-drawer.selected.item.trailing-icon.color), anything else as it draws itself; WHILE the slot is empty and trailingText is not empty it SHALL draw trailingText there, on one line and never truncated, in comp.navigation-drawer.item.trailing-text.typescale and its condition's trailing text color (comp.navigation-drawer.unselected.item.trailing-text.color, comp.navigation-drawer.selected.item.trailing-text.color); IF both are given it SHALL draw the slot's content and in debug builds report trailingText. IF the slot holds a focusable element THE navigation drawer SHALL keep it out of the focus order, and in debug builds report that trailing content is not interactive.

THE navigation drawer SHALL draw a group's row as a destination's in either form (NVD-13, NVD-32), with its icon, label and short label, its trailing content (NVD-43, a group's trailing slot and trailingText as a destination's), and its chevron where chevron puts it (NVD-68): the icon set's expand_more at comp.navigation-drawer.item.trailing-icon.size.regular in its condition's trailing icon color, turned half a turn WHILE the group is open; WHILE the group is open and the drawer expanded it SHALL draw the group's items below its row, each one's row starting one step of indent further in (NVD-69, NVD-70); WHEN open changes it SHALL reveal or hide those items, moving the cells below, and turn the chevron, over comp.navigation-drawer.motion.disclosure-duration with comp.navigation-drawer.motion.disclosure-easing, at once where motion is reduced. A group's row SHALL answer hover, focus and press, show its focus ring, and follow press-hold, pressed-feedback, corner smoothing and focus style exactly as a destination does (NVD-4 to NVD-10), from the unselected condition unless NVD-47 says otherwise.

WHEN the user activates, WHILE expandable is true and the drawer is expanded, a group's row by pointer, touch, Enter or Space and the group is not a destination (NVD-66), or activates the chevron of a group that is one (NVD-67), or the icon of a group while chevron is none (NVD-68), THE navigation drawer SHALL emit the group's toggle exactly once with its new open state, SHALL NOT emit change, reselect or close, and on the web SHALL set the group's open itself (a controlled platform leaves it to the caller); WHEN focus is on a closed group's row and the user presses the arrow key toward the end of the line (Right in a left-to-right layout) it SHALL open the group, and on an open group's row the arrow key toward the start SHALL close it; WHEN focus is on an item inside an open group and the user presses the arrow key toward the start, it SHALL move focus to that group's row. WHILE a group's disabled is true THE navigation drawer SHALL NOT emit toggle, change or reselect for it, SHALL NOT make its row or its chevron focusable and SHALL expose it as disabled.

THE navigation drawer SHALL expose a group's row as one button named by its label, with its expanded or collapsed state and its icon and chevron hidden, controlling its items, and its items as a list named by the group's label inside the drawer's list: on the web a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls and a nested list labelled by it; on Apple platforms a button whose value is expanded or collapsed, as a disclosure group reads; on Android the expanded state with the expand and collapse actions; in Flutter the expanded semantics flag; in React Native accessibilityState.expanded. WHILE a group is a destination (NVD-66) THE navigation drawer SHALL instead expose its row as that destination, as NVD-23 says (a link while it has an href and a button otherwise, named by its label, with its selected state), and its chevron as one more button, named by the group's label, with the group's expanded or collapsed state and controlling its items, which stay a list named by the group's label: on the web the row is the link or button with aria-current and the chevron a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls, each its own Tab stop, as the disclosure navigation menu with top-level links of the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices is; on the other platforms the row carries the selected state and the chevron the expanded state with the expand and collapse actions. WHILE expandable is false, NVD-72 says instead what a group's row is. WHILE a group is closed, or the drawer collapsed, its items SHALL be neither exposed nor focusable. WHILE a group's label is empty and the product gives the group a name of its own on the element — aria-label, or aria-labelledby naming an element — THE navigation drawer SHALL expose that name as its row's accessible name; WHILE a group's label is empty and the product gives it none THE navigation drawer SHALL still render it, and in debug builds report that it has no accessible name.

WHILE the selected destination is inside a closed group, or inside a group WHILE the drawer is collapsed, THE navigation drawer SHALL draw the row that shows it (the outermost closed group that holds it; collapsed, its top-level group) from its form's selected condition; WHILE the drawer is collapsed it SHALL draw each top-level group as one cell and none of its items; WHEN the user activates the cell of a group that is not a destination (NVD-66) WHILE the drawer is collapsed THE navigation drawer SHALL emit expandedChange with true, and the group's toggle with true WHILE it is closed, SHALL on the web apply both itself, and SHALL move focus to the group's row once the drawer is expanded.

IF groups nest more than three levels deep THE navigation drawer SHALL still render them, indenting each level's content by comp.navigation-drawer.item.nest-indent.regular, and in debug builds report the depth.

WHILE the drawer is collapsed and a top-level destination or group has no icon THE navigation drawer SHALL still draw its cell, with an empty icon indicator and, WHERE NVD-33 draws one, its short label, and in debug builds report that a collapsible drawer needs an icon on every top-level destination and group.

THE navigation drawer SHALL take its layout direction from where it is used — the direction of the nearest ancestor that sets one, and the platform's own where none does — and SHALL have no direction setting of its own; WHEN that direction changes while the navigation drawer is shown THE navigation drawer SHALL draw itself for the new direction at once, without a motion of its own, keeping its expanded or collapsed form, its open state, the selected destination and its focus.
behavior.verify: Test with the direction set on an ancestor inside the page or the view tree, not on the root, and again changed after the first render. On the web the test is owed with the other right-to-left tests.

behavior.text: WHERE the layout direction is right-to-left THE navigation drawer SHALL draw a destination's and a group's icon mirrored left to right exactly when the system's icon set marks that glyph's name as mirrored or the product forces mirroring for that use, and unmirrored when the product forbids it: the icon helper mirrors the glyph inside its own box, about the box's vertical centre line, changing neither its place, size, color and fill nor the order NVD-13 gives. THE navigation drawer SHALL NOT mirror a glyph itself, and SHALL NOT mirror content the product gives as an image or a view of its own rather than by a glyph's name. A group's chevron (expand_more, NVD-44) is not marked and is never mirrored; the product's own content in a trailing slot is the product's to mirror, and a header button's and the main action's glyphs are mirrored by those components (BTN-19, MAB-22).

Test one marked and one unmarked name in right-to-left, the marked one again with mirroring forbidden and the unmarked one with it forced, and the marked one in left-to-right (never mirrored there).

behavior.text: THE navigation drawer SHALL lay out a destination's and a group's label and short label, a section's heading, a destination's trailing text and the header's text as text of its own direction, isolated from the text around it: each takes the base direction of its first strong character, or the layout direction where it has none, so that a left-to-right word, a number with its sign or unit, a telephone number and an address keep their own order in a right-to-left layout and reorder nothing beside them; THE navigation drawer SHALL still place each and align its lines by the layout direction, not by the text's own, and SHALL cut a short label that does not fit (NVD-32) at the end of its own direction, so that a left-to-right label in a right-to-left layout loses its right end and never its beginning.

WHILE responsive is true THE navigation drawer SHALL choose its presentation from the width of the window it is in, and SHALL ignore variant: WHILE the window is at least comp.navigation-drawer.breakpoint.expanded wide it SHALL be a standard drawer that is shown whatever open says (the standard presentation: NVD-18's place in the layout, in the form NVD-30 gives a standard drawer); WHILE the window is narrower than that, at least comp.navigation-drawer.breakpoint.collapsed wide, and collapsible is true, it SHALL be a collapsible modal drawer (the column presentation: its column in the layout, widening over the content WHILE open is true, NVD-40); and otherwise it SHALL be a modal drawer that is not collapsible (the modal presentation: nothing in the layout, shown over the content WHILE open is true, NVD-19 to NVD-22). behavior.text: WHEN the window's width takes a responsive drawer from one presentation to another THE navigation drawer SHALL draw the new presentation at once, without the motions of NVD-18, NVD-35 and NVD-40; SHALL enter it closed — WHERE open is true it SHALL emit close exactly once, the web setting open to false itself and a controlled platform leaving it to the caller (NVD-20); SHALL keep expanded, which only the user's request (NVD-37) and the product change, so that the standard presentation returns in the form it was left in; SHALL keep value and every group's open; and SHALL emit presentationChange exactly once with the new presentation (standard, column or modal). It SHALL also emit presentationChange exactly once WHEN the presentation is first decided. IF keyboard focus is on something the new presentation does not show THE navigation drawer SHALL move it to the menu button (NVD-37), or else to the first focusable element it still shows, and WHERE it shows nothing SHALL leave focus to the platform; focus that an open modal presentation kept inside the drawer SHALL be free to leave once the drawer is standard.

behavior.text: THE navigation drawer SHALL hold three things apart WHILE responsive is true: the presentation, which it derives from the window's width alone, never stores, never writes into variant, open or expanded, and exposes read-only; open, which is transient, false unless the product or the menu button has just asked, and false again after every change of presentation and every close (NVD-20, NVD-21); and expanded, the user's choice of form for the standard presentation, which THE navigation drawer SHALL NOT persist beyond its own lifetime — a product that wants the choice remembered stores what expandedChange carries and sets expanded from it. WHEN a responsive drawer first appears THE navigation drawer SHALL draw the presentation of the current width in its first frame, without motion and without emitting close; WHERE it is rendered before the width is known (a page rendered on a server) it SHALL render no modal presentation open, SHALL make nothing inert, and SHALL decide both only once the width is known.

behavior.text: WHILE the drawer is collapsed and a cell draws no short label (NVD-33), and WHILE it is expanded and a row's label or supporting text is cut (NVD-75), THE navigation drawer SHALL show that cell's label (and, where its supporting text is cut, its supporting text after it), WHEN the cell is hovered with a fine pointer or receives keyboard focus, as the platform shows the name of a control that is an icon alone (a plain tooltip beside the cell, toward the content, on the web and on desktop; nothing more than the large-content viewer of NVD-27 on a touch platform), and SHALL NOT add it to the cell's accessible name or description, which already hold it.

behavior.text: WHEN the navigation drawer first appears in the layout with a selected destination, and WHEN value changes while it is shown, THE navigation drawer SHALL bring the row that shows the selection (the selected destination, or the group's row NVD-47 names) into view: IF that row is not wholly inside the space its items scroll in THE navigation drawer SHALL scroll them so that the row is centered in that space, as far as the scroll range allows, and otherwise it SHALL NOT scroll at all, so that a drawer whose selection is already in view stays where it is from one page to the next. It SHALL do so at once, without motion, WHEN the drawer first appears in its first frame (in the order NVD-62 gives), and SHALL NOT move keyboard focus. A modal presentation is brought there WHEN it opens, by the focus NVD-19 gives.

behavior.text: WHILE revealSelected is true THE navigation drawer SHALL, WHEN it first appears with a selected destination and WHEN value changes to a destination, draw every closed group that holds that destination open — and, WHERE the selected destination is a group (NVD-66), that group as well, so that a site's sidebar shows the pages of the section whose page is shown — whatever its open said (a state the product gave back included, NVD-62), and SHALL emit each such group's toggle exactly once with true, the web setting the group's open itself and a controlled platform leaving its open to the caller, as NVD-45 says; WHEN the drawer first appears it SHALL draw them open in its first frame, without the motion of NVD-44, and afterwards with it. It SHALL NOT emit change, reselect or close for it, and SHALL NOT open again a group the user closes afterwards until value changes: that group's row then shows the selection (NVD-47). WHILE the drawer is collapsed it SHALL open them all the same, for the form in which they are drawn. WHILE revealSelected is false THE navigation drawer SHALL leave every group as its open says.

Test: closing Components by its row then draws its row selected, and it stays closed until value changes; `group-closed-selected` (revealSelected false) is drawn as before.

behavior.text: WHILE a destination's href is not empty THE navigation drawer SHALL make it a link to that address and not a button. On the web it SHALL be an anchor element with that address, whose behaviours are the browser's own — following it on a plain click, a touch or Enter; opening it in another tab or window by a modified click or a middle click; the link's context menu; dragging it; copying its address; showing its address on hover — and THE navigation drawer SHALL NOT prevent, replace or imitate any of them; Space SHALL NOT activate a link. On other platforms it SHALL be the platform's own link (SwiftUI's Link; on Compose, Flutter and React Native an element with the platform's link semantics whose address is opened by the platform's opener), as BTN-22 says for a link button. THE navigation drawer SHALL draw a link exactly as it draws a button destination, from the same tokens in every state and both forms (NVD-3, NVD-4, NVD-7 to NVD-9, NVD-13, NVD-32), SHALL draw no look of its own for a link the user has visited, and SHALL give its hit area (NVD-6) to the link. WHILE a link's value is empty THE navigation drawer SHALL take its href as its value, for value, change, reselect and NVD-29. WHILE a link's disabled is true it SHALL keep the link role with the disabled state and no destination, and SHALL open nothing by any means the platform gives a link (NVD-2; on the web the anchor carries no address).
behavior.verify: Test on the web: a control-click, a command-click, a shift-click and a middle click on a link destination open what the browser opens for a plain anchor; the context menu is the link's; the drawer has called preventDefault on none of them.

behavior.text: WHEN the user activates a link destination THE navigation drawer SHALL count it as an activation (NVD-1, NVD-21) only WHILE it follows the link in the place where the product is shown: a click with the primary button and no modifier key, a touch, Enter, or the default action of assistive technology, on a link whose target is same and that asks for no download. It SHALL then emit change or reselect exactly once, carrying the destination's value and its href, before the link is followed, and SHALL NOT hold the link back for sys.motion.duration.press-hold; SHALL NOT write value itself on any platform, because where the product is, is the product's to say, and the page or the route shown next sets value; and SHALL let the link be followed unless the product cancels the event (preventDefault on the web), as a product does that moves between its pages without loading a document. For every other activation of a link — a modified or a middle click, a link whose target is new, a download — THE navigation drawer SHALL emit neither change nor reselect, SHALL NOT close, and SHALL keep value and the drawn selection as they are.
behavior.verify: Test on the web: a plain click on a link that is not selected emits one change with `detail.value` and `detail.href`, leaves the drawer's value as it was and navigates; with the event cancelled it does not navigate; a control-click emits nothing and an open modal drawer stays open; a plain click in an open modal drawer emits change and then close.

behavior.text: THE navigation drawer SHALL hold how far its items are scrolled from their start as scrollOffset, in the units of its layout: it SHALL give the present distance whenever the product reads it, and WHEN the product sets it, before the drawer first appears included, SHALL scroll there at once and without motion, held inside the scroll range, the header staying in place (NVD-12). Scrolling by the user SHALL emit no event. WHILE the items can scroll, a scroll that reaches either end of them SHALL NOT go on to scroll what is beside or behind the drawer. WHEN a group opens or closes (NVD-44) THE navigation drawer SHALL keep that group's row where it is in view and move only the cells after it; WHEN keyboard focus moves to a cell that is not wholly in view it SHALL scroll that cell into view by the least distance that shows it whole.
behavior.verify: Test in `site-sidebar-long`: setting scrollOffset to 5000 gives 3224, the end of the range in a frame 800 high; a wheel turned past the end of the items leaves the page behind where it was; closing Foundations with its row at 200 from the top leaves the row at 200.

behavior.text: THE navigation drawer SHALL treat scrollOffset and every group's open as the state of one view, as NVD-55 treats expanded: it SHALL keep neither beyond its own lifetime and SHALL write neither to any storage. A product whose pages are separate documents keeps what each group's toggle carries, and what scrollOffset reads when a page is left, and gives them back as the groups' open and the drawer's scrollOffset when the next page is rendered. WHEN the drawer first appears THE navigation drawer SHALL build its first frame in this order — every group as its open says; then the groups NVD-58 opens; then the items at scrollOffset; then the selection brought into view (NVD-57) — and SHALL draw it without the motions of NVD-41 and NVD-44 and without emitting change, reselect or close.
behavior.verify: Test: a drawer rendered with two groups' open set, a scrollOffset and a value shows all four in its first frame and animates nothing; nothing is read from or written to the browser's storage at any time.

behavior.text: WHILE a destination is a link and its target is new THE navigation drawer SHALL open its href in a new context, as BTN-24 says for a link button (on the web a new tab or window that is given no handle to the page that opened it), and, WHILE the drawer is expanded and the destination has neither trailing slot content nor trailingText, SHALL draw the glyph open_in_new of the system's icon set as its trailing content, as NVD-43 draws a glyph: at comp.navigation-drawer.item.trailing-icon.size.regular, in its condition's trailing icon color (comp.navigation-drawer.unselected.item.trailing-icon.color, comp.navigation-drawer.selected.item.trailing-icon.color), through the icon helper, which mirrors it in a right-to-left layout because the icon set marks its name, and hidden from assistive technology; WHILE the product has put trailing content there THE navigation drawer SHALL draw no mark of its own. Whether a mark is drawn or not, and in both forms, it SHALL expose targetLabel as part of the destination's description, after its badge's description and its trailing content (NVD-15), and WHILE targetLabel is empty SHALL still render and in debug builds report that a link that opens a new context does not say so. WHILE target is same THE navigation drawer SHALL draw no mark and SHALL ignore targetLabel.
behavior.verify: `site-sidebar`: Source code ends in open_in_new and is described as "opens in a new tab"; no other row has a mark.

behavior.text: WHEN a destination's target names a value the navigation drawer does not define THE navigation drawer SHALL treat it as same, and in debug builds report the unknown value. IF a destination's href is only white space, or names a script to run rather than a place to go (the web's javascript: scheme), or cannot be read as an address by the platform, THE navigation drawer SHALL make the destination a button without a destination, and in the last two cases report it in debug builds, as BTN-26 says for a button. WHILE a destination's href is empty THE navigation drawer SHALL ignore its target and targetLabel.

THE navigation drawer SHALL draw its cells, its section headings, the gaps between its cells, its nesting indent and its collapsed column from the tokens of its density: WHILE density is regular from comp.navigation-drawer.container.gap.regular, comp.navigation-drawer.item.container.height.regular, comp.navigation-drawer.item.padding-inline.regular, comp.navigation-drawer.item.padding-block.regular, comp.navigation-drawer.item.nest-indent.regular, comp.navigation-drawer.item.icon.size.regular, comp.navigation-drawer.item.icon-indicator.width.regular, comp.navigation-drawer.item.icon-indicator.height.regular, comp.navigation-drawer.item.label.typescale.regular, comp.navigation-drawer.item.trailing-icon.size.regular, comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.container.width.regular, comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.item.container.width.regular, comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.item.container.padding-block.regular and comp.navigation-drawer.heading.height.regular, and WHILE density is compact from comp.navigation-drawer.container.gap.compact, comp.navigation-drawer.item.container.height.compact, comp.navigation-drawer.item.padding-inline.compact, comp.navigation-drawer.item.padding-block.compact, comp.navigation-drawer.item.nest-indent.compact, comp.navigation-drawer.item.icon.size.compact, comp.navigation-drawer.item.icon-indicator.width.compact, comp.navigation-drawer.item.icon-indicator.height.compact, comp.navigation-drawer.item.label.typescale.compact, comp.navigation-drawer.item.trailing-icon.size.compact, comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.container.width.compact, comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.item.container.width.compact, comp.navigation-drawer.collapsed.item.container.padding-block.compact and comp.navigation-drawer.heading.height.compact. No density SHALL change comp.navigation-drawer.item.gap, the room between the icon (or its room), the label and the trailing content, as no density changes the tree view's. Wherever another behaviour names one of these tokens by its regular value, THE navigation drawer SHALL read the value of its density instead, in both forms and while moving between them, so that every icon keeps one point in both forms (NVD-31) in each density and a nested destination's icon stands where its group's label starts in each. WHEN density changes while the drawer is shown THE navigation drawer SHALL draw the new density at once, without the motions of NVD-35, NVD-41 and NVD-44, keeping its form, its selection, every group's open, its scroll offset where the range allows, and focus, and SHALL emit nothing for it.

Test: setting density to compact and back on a shown drawer emits nothing and keeps focus on the cell that had it.

behavior.text: WHILE selectableGroups is true THE navigation drawer SHALL treat each group whose value or href is not empty as a destination as well as a group: the drawer's value SHALL select it as it selects a destination, its href standing as its value while its value is empty (NVD-59), and NVD-29 SHALL count it among the destinations in reading order, before the items it holds; its row SHALL be drawn from the selected parts in its form while it is selected (NVD-3, NVD-41) and from the parts NVD-47 names while it is not and a destination it holds is shown by it; its activation SHALL emit change or reselect as NVD-1 says and close a modal drawer as NVD-21 says; and WHILE its href is not empty its row SHALL be a link as NVD-59, NVD-60 and NVD-64 say, opened where the person is. WHILE selectableGroups is false, and for a group whose value and href are both empty, THE navigation drawer SHALL ignore the group's value and href, the group SHALL only open and close (NVD-45), and in debug builds it SHALL report once a group that has a value or an href while selectableGroups is false. WHEN selectableGroups changes while the drawer is shown THE navigation drawer SHALL draw the new form of each group at once, keeping value, every group's open and focus where the element that had it is still drawn, and SHALL emit nothing for it.

behavior.text: WHILE a group is a destination (NVD-66) and the drawer is expanded THE navigation drawer SHALL split its row in two: its chevron SHALL be a control of its own, which opens and closes the group as NVD-45 says and SHALL NOT change the selection, and the rest of the row SHALL be the destination, which a press, Enter or Space (Enter alone for a link) activates as NVD-1 says and which SHALL NOT open or close the group: the chevron opens and the row chooses, and one press never does both. The chevron's hit area SHALL be the part of the cell's hit area from the middle of the gap before the chevron's box to the cell's end edge, at least sys.target.pointer wide for a fine pointer and sys.target.touch wide for touch, reaching over the end of the label where the row gives less; the rest of the cell's hit area SHALL be the row's. A hover anywhere on the cell SHALL show on the item container, a press on the chevron SHALL show the pressed state on the item container as a press on the row does (NVD-8, NVD-9), and keyboard focus on the chevron SHALL show the focus ring around the chevron's own box, at the corners of the item container, and not around the row. WHILE the drawer is collapsed the group's cell SHALL be the destination alone: its activation SHALL emit change or reselect, and SHALL NOT expand the drawer or open the group; its items are reached by expanding the drawer.
